verdict.line: You lose extended 1v1s only if Yorick lands Mourning Mist and boxes you against Dark Procession before level 6; past that, Test of Spirit turns every stand-and-fight into your win.

brief.thesis: Yorick's kit is built to stall and split-push, not to burst — his only hard zoning tool is the Dark Procession (W) wall, and once that's down Illaoi's Test of Spirit (E) traps him in a spirit-echo loop he can't out-heal with Last Rites (Q) alone. The 58.6% win rate over 58 games and Illaoi-favoured solo-kill stat both come from the same source: this is a stand-still-and-trade matchup, and Illaoi's kit is built for exactly that.

theirWindow.when: W and E both off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He can wall you off from minions/tentacles, land Mourning Mist's armor shred and slow, then free-hit with an empowered Last Rites to heal. Don't commit to a trade near terrain he can wall you into until you've seen this combo used or baited it out.

yourWindow.when: Test of Spirit connects and he runs
yourWindow.what: Chase him down — the spirit echoes a percentage of all damage you deal back onto him, and if he dies or breaks line of sight too far he becomes a Vessel spawning Tentacles. Every extended fight after this point snowballs in your favor.

start.why: Matches Yorick's Last Rites sustain in the level 1-5 poke war where his cooldown (6-4s) outpaces your Test of Spirit (16-12s).

boots.why: Flattens the chip damage from his empowered Last Rites autos and summoned Mist Walkers, which are the only consistent harass he has before 6.

core.why: Shred through the armor he's already cutting with Mourning Mist and keep up in extended trades.
The CDR and bonus damage proc pair with Harsh Lesson (W) resets for repeated spirit/vessel punishment.
Survivability spike that lets you tank through a Last Rites heal-trade and still win the fight.

the Maiden of the Mist (R) turns the game into a sustain race post-6-item
you want extra burst and a crit-based reset on your W/E all-ins

runes.keystoneWhy: Out-sustains his Last Rites healing in the slow, stand-still trades this matchup is built around.

summoners.why: Exhaust (70% win rate) shuts down his Last Rites heal and attack speed the moment he tries to extend a trade behind Dark Procession; Teleport answers his split-push pressure if he disengages lane entirely to shove side waves.

playing.title: Respect Last Rites pre-6
playing.detail: His Q cooldown (6-4s) means he can out-trade you in short pokes before your E is low enough cooldown to answer. Don't force extended exchanges until level 6.

playing.title: Land E before he walls
playing.detail: Test of Spirit's 900 range outranges his Dark Procession's 600 range — fire it before he can set up the wall, not after he's already boxed you in.

playing.title: Track his W before committing
playing.detail: If Dark Procession is up near terrain, assume he'll try to isolate you in a pocket with Mourning Mist following. Trade from open ground instead.

playing.title: All-in once Leap of Faith is up
playing.detail: From level 6 on, use Leap of Faith to spawn a Tentacle directly on him and follow with Harsh Lesson — the Tentacle swings alone will out-damage his heal.

playing.title: Chase vessels, don't reset
playing.detail: Once Test of Spirit forces a Vessel, stay on him — the spawned Tentacles keep punishing him even if you disengage, so pressing the kill is pure upside.

playing.title: Ward your flanks after 6
playing.detail: Yorick's Maiden of the Mist can raise Walkers off dead enemies in nearby skirmishes; don't let a dead jungler creep turn into reinforcements mid-fight.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability breakdowns, timing windows, and tactical reasoning are my own read of the matchup, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Try to not get caught in Yorick’s (W)-(E) but if you get caught inside (W), use [Q] to get rid of (P) quickly and escape form (W). Use [E] while keeping your distance to harass and contest lane.
